item.title: Braid 0.0.14
item.description:
• Share Capture One sessions with clients for online review.
  • Client ratings and colour tags sync back to Capture One.
  • Gallery edits sync even while Braid is closed.
  • Get a notification when a client edit reaches Capture One.
  • Switch the source to a connected backup drive and keep the same gallery link.
  • Card Check turns green only when a backup drive is connected.
  • Braid asks before removing many files from your drives.
  • LiveSync recovers on its own after brief drive hiccups.
